coverage_assessment: Twenty-one open-web searches are logged across all four January weekly windows, Tok Pisin/local names, local news archives, land/mining, Bougainville, university and labor sectors, urban regions, COVID policy, and December/February boundaries. Nineteen source cards are recorded: 15 opened and four search_only. Four non-gathering or out-of-month leads are preserved with reasons. One January sit-in is supported for date, site and state-directed compensation demand; attendance, physical end, violence and state response remain unknown. Four returned search-title fields are null where titles could not be cleanly separated; URLs and reference IDs are retained. Coverage is bounded and not exhaustive.
